MeowTrail Cheats & Solutions

Stuck on a puzzle? Use our free online solver — enter your grid and get the answer instantly.

💡 Before You Cheat — Try These Hints

  1. Start with "4" cells — all 4 neighbors must be bulbs
  2. Start with "0" cells — all 4 neighbors must be empty
  3. Look for forced positions — cells that can only be lit from one direction
  4. Count remaining spots — if a "3" has 2 neighbors blocked, the other 2 must be bulbs
